verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented API versioning scheme or deprecation policy for AutoGen. The only related item is a migration guide from 0.2.x to 0.4.x. That shows versions changed but is an adjacent artifact, not a stated deprecation or support-window policy, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
